summary: Iteration 54 — Auto-Pilot + Device Compare + Streak Reminder full-stack testing. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed (autopilot admin unlimited, start→agent/result→done with delta_score, tweaks_applied counter bump +2, starter limit=1 and 402 code=autopilot_limit, /api/devices/compare 2 devices with health+live+specs, auth required 401, autopilot mode in _ALLOWED_URI_MODES, scheduler cron hour=17 registered, streak reminder idempotent — set reminder_day=today on first run, no change on second run, original daily state restored). Frontend playwright: admin dashboard shows autopilot-card with quota 'Unlimited', autopilot-start-btn + autopilot-report-toggle + autopilot-report (2 tweaks applied, health 68→68 shown, powergaming_mode); /app/pc shows device-compare with compare-gaming-rig + compare-stream-box, compare-suffering-gaming-rig badge on ONLY the worst PC (gaming-rig), stream-box has no suffering badge; milestones daily-block present; device-switcher-btn present. Starter: autopilot-card shows quota 'Free: 1 per week · 0/1' with autopilot-locked + autopilot-upgrade-link (start button correctly hidden as remaining=0 after used=1 from backend tests); /app/pc has NO device-compare (only 1 device).

issues: Report text renders as concatenated tokens '2tweaks applied6868Healthpowergaming_mode' due to missing whitespace/separators between numbers, labels and applied tweak chips. Numeric before/after scores (68 68) are legible but visually collapsed. Consider adding gap/spacing between value+label pairs and comma-separating applied tweaks.
Recharts warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart container mounts before layout has size. Not user-visible but noisy.

action_items: Minor: fix AutoPilotCard report spacing (design issue only, no functional bug).
Minor: guard Recharts ResponsiveContainer with minHeight to eliminate console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: autopilot.py _quota counts both 'pending' and 'done' toward weekly quota — a Free user who starts but never finishes (agent never fires) will still consume 1/week. Consider excluding 'pending' older than N minutes, or resetting stale pendings before counting.

autopilot.py POST /agent/result has no correlation between the reported run and the start (finds most-recent pending by user). If two starts race (two devices), only the latest pending gets updated. Consider passing run_id back to the agent.
devices.py /compare returns devices without deterministic ordering — frontend suffering-badge logic depends on stable comparison; verify sort by first_seen for consistent UX.
Streak reminder scheduled_streak_reminders() sends push then always writes reminder_day=today — if push fails midway, subsequent runs still won't retry today (acceptable trade-off but note it).
seed_data_creation: Tests create autopilot_runs for admin (multiple start→done cycles) — safe to leave (admin is streamer unlimited). Starter had used=1 already; test verified 402 without creating extra runs. daily.streak_day was toggled to yesterday during idempotent test and RESTORED to original at end (restored $set/$unset based on captured state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression tests at /app/backend/tests/test_autopilot_compare_streak.py cover: autopilot quota+flow+counter, devices/compare, URI mode allow-list, streak reminder idempotency and scheduler registration. Admin agent token retrievable via GET /api/agent/token (cookie auth). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. For streak test, the script temporarily patches server.db to the test motor client to reuse the async function.
